facts: Index placed ads by the message they're anchored below, so the transcript render can drop each ad in right after its anchor message.

Product surfaces the ads API maps to Gravity placements. 'waiting_room' is the legacy wire name for the freebuff landing screen; 'cli_chat' is the inline transcript ad in the coding-agent chat. Values must match the server's AD_SURFACES enum, so don't rename them.

entries.title: CLI update: chat

ai.title: Inline ad banners interleaved into the chat transcript
ai.summary: The CLI now interleaves ads directly into the chat transcript instead of showing a single rotating `ads[0]` slot below the input, so each completed assistant answer can carry its own anchored ad that stays in scrollback. `useGravityAd` gained an `inline` option and a `placedAds` buffer; `chat.tsx` reads `placedAds` and renders `<InlineAdBanner>` after each anchored message, indexed by `afterMessageId` from `placedAds`. Placement is governed by the new pure helpers `isCompletedAnswer`, `inlineAdAnchorIds`, and `computeInlineAdAdditions`, which anchor to top-level streamed AI answers (id prefix `AI_MESSAGE_ID_PREFIX` from the new `cli/src/utils/ai-message-id.ts` leaf module) spaced by the `AD_FIRST_ANSWER_OFFSET` and `AD_STEP_EXCHANGES` pacing knobs, and the hook now passes `surface: 'cli_chat'` to match the server's `AdSurface` enum. This change also adds Windows coverage to `terminal-watchdog.ts` and exposes `SystemRoot` to the CLI env types and helpers.
ai.evidence: cli/src/chat.tsx swaps the single-slot `ads?.[0]` rendering of `SingleAdBanner` for an inline loop that reads `placedAds` from useGravityAd({ inline: true, surface: 'cli_chat' }) and renders `InlineAdBanner` after each anchored message; cli/src/hooks/use-gravity-ad.ts adds the `inline` option, `placedAds`/`PlacedAd`, `isCompletedAnswer`, `inlineAdAnchorIds`, `computeInlineAdAdditions`, the `cli_chat` surface, and the `AD_FIRST_ANSWER_OFFSET`/`AD_STEP_EXCHANGES` pacing knobs; cli/src/components/ad-banner.tsx adds the `InlineAdBanner` component; cli/src/utils/ai-message-id.ts is a new leaf module exporting `AI_MESSAGE_ID_PREFIX`; cli/src/utils/send-message-helpers.ts re-exports `AI_MESSAGE_ID_PREFIX` from that leaf instead of defining it locally; cli/src/utils/terminal-watchdog.ts adds Windows watchdog support via a PowerShell bootstrap grandchild and a disarm file, and cli/src/types/env.ts plus cli/src/utils/env.ts add the `SystemRoot` env field
ai.unknowns: The rollout of the `cli_chat` inline surface and whether the server has finished mapping it to Gravity placements is not visible in this diff

changes.what: Adds inline ad placement state and logic: `inline` option, `placedAds`/`PlacedAd`, `isCompletedAnswer`, `inlineAdAnchorIds`, `computeInlineAdAdditions`, the `cli_chat` surface, and `AD_FIRST_ANSWER_OFFSET`/`AD_STEP_EXCHANGES` pacing constants
Renders `InlineAdBanner` after each anchored transcript message via `placedAds` instead of a single `SingleAdBanner` slot, passing `inline: true` and `surface: 'cli_chat'` to `useGravityAd`

facts: Count structured message content (not JSON.stringify, which inflates the count and counts image base64 as text); system is a plain string; tool schemas stay JSON since that's roughly how the model sees them.

Flat per-image/file cost. Anthropic bills a large image at ~1600 tokens; we use that ceiling instead of counting the base64 as text (which JSON.stringify would do), where a single screenshot is hundreds of thousands of chars.
Per-message structural overhead (role marker, delimiters) Anthropic adds on top of the raw content.
JSON.stringify(undefined) returns undefined; fall back to '' so countTokens always gets a string.
entries.title: Agent Runtime update: run-agent-step

ai.title: Structured token counting replaces JSON.stringify in Agent Runtime
ai.summary: Agent Runtime switches from `countTokensJson` to `countTokensMessages` for message history and `countTokens` for system prompts. `JSON.stringify` inflated counts by treating image base64 as text and adding JSON envelope overhead; `countTokensMessages` counts structured content (text, tool inputs/results) with a flat 1600-token image cost and 8-token per-message overhead. `countTokensJson` now handles `undefined` via `?? ''` fallback. Applies to `packages/agent-runtime/src/util/token-counter.ts`, `run-agent-step.ts`, and `messages.ts`.

eli5.text: The way the software counts how much text and images fit into a single conversation turn with the AI has gotten more accurate. When you chat with the assistant, it now estimates the token cost of your messages, especially any screenshots or images you attach, using a flat per-image charge and a small overhead per message, instead of guessing based on the raw text length of the image data. This means the system will make better decisions about when your message history is getting too long and needs to be trimmed, and it won't overcount the size of images you send. The change is live today in the agent runtime that powers the assistant's step-by-step reasoning.

Transient-failure retry for the HTTP hop. Only retries when the request never reached Convex (network/fetch errors), a thrown application error is surfaced immediately, and we never blind-retry mutations that may have committed (double-applied stream deltas are worse than a dropped flush).
Long-lived websocket client for subscriptions (queue + per-run status).
Quiet-run heartbeat: an empty batch bumps last_event_at so the sweep knows the runner is alive during long tool calls with no streamed output.

entries.title: New packaging files landed

ai.title: Freebuff Runner package added to offload agent turns from Convex
ai.summary: The `@codebuff/freebuff-runner` Bun worker is added under `freebuff/runner/` so Freebuff, Codex, and Claude Code agent turns run off Convex action compute. It subscribes over websocket to runner-dispatched `queued` rows in `freebuff_agent_runs`, claims them with a CAS mutation, and streams batched events through `recordRunEventBatch`. Dispatch is gated by the `freebuff_runner_enabled` feature flag, which now defaults ON for those send types, with the legacy Convex action and workflow paths remaining as fallback. The event batcher ships every buffered delta in one mutation per ~2s and sends a 30000ms heartbeat to keep the run alive during long tool calls with no streamed output.
ai.evidence: Commit [f7828c2c] adds the `freebuff/runner/` package as nine new files, including `src/main.ts` (CAS claim loop over a websocket subscription to `queued` rows in `freebuff_agent_runs`), `src/convexBridge.ts` (`createRunnerCtx` and `createSubscriptionClient` implementing `RunnerCtx` over `ConvexHttpClient` + websocket), and `src/eventBatcher.ts` (`createEventBatcher` shipping all buffered events as one `recordRunEventBatch` mutation per 2s, plus a 30_000ms `HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS`), with the README stating dispatch is gated by the `freebuff_runner_enabled` feature flag that now defaults ON for Freebuff, Codex, and Claude Code sends.
ai.unknowns: The commit does not show the consumer of the `freebuff_runner_enabled` flag in `convex/featureFlags.ts` or the `recordRunEventBatch` mutation, so whether the flag wiring already reads ON by default is not visible in this diff.

changes.what: Adds the `@codebuff/freebuff-runner` package manifest defining a private Bun worker with start/dev/typecheck scripts and workspace dependencies on `@codebuff/common`, `@codebuff/sdk`, `@daytonaio/sdk`, `convex`, and `diff`.
Adds a tsconfig extending `../../tsconfig.base.json` with a `!` path alias mapped to `../web/convex/*` and JSX support for the Convex web tree imported by the runner.

Adds README documenting the long-lived Bun worker design, the `freebuff_runner_enabled` flag rollout (defaults ON), the deploy order warning, environment variables, Render service config, and local dev entrypoint `bun --cwd freebuff/runner dev`.

Adds `convexBridge.ts` exposing `RunnerCtx` (runQuery/runMutation/runAction plus HTTP-backed storage) built via `createRunnerCtx` over `ConvexHttpClient` with transient-failure retry, and `createSubscriptionClient` for websocket subscriptions.

Adds `eventBatcher.ts` exporting `createEventBatcher` that batches all buffered stream events into one `recordRunEventBatch` mutation per 2000ms flush window, with a 30000ms heartbeat and delta-merging for contiguous stream chunks.

Adds `main.ts` as the Render entrypoint: subscribes to the `queued` run queue over websocket, claims runs with a CAS mutation, executes turns via `runFreebuffTurn` or `runCliTurn`, and on SIGTERM persists resume state and requeues active runs.

entries.title: Agents cleanup: code-reviewer-minimax

ai.title: MiniMax M2.7 removed from free agent modes
ai.summary: Free and lite modes now exclusively route to MiniMax M3, removing the legacy M2.7 model ID from constants, agent definitions, and context pruner logic. This change consolidates free-tier model selection and drops support for the deprecated 'Fastest' MiniMax variant, updating root and reviewer agent mappings in `free-agents.ts` and `freebuff-models.ts`. The `code-reviewer-minimax.ts` file is deleted, and context length constraints for M2.7 are removed from `base2.ts`.

eli5.text: The free assistant that helps you write code now uses only the newer MiniMax M3 model instead of the older M2.7 variant. If you use the free or lite mode, you are seeing the updated MiniMax M3 model being used automatically, and the older M2.7 model support has been completely removed from the system. The change is live today for all free and lite users, and behind the scenes it removes outdated model configurations and a separate reviewer agent that was built specifically for the old model.

ai.title: runner tsconfig maps @codebuff/sdk to source
ai.summary: Added path mapping for @codebuff/sdk to ../../sdk/src/index.ts in freebuff/runner/tsconfig.json. This ensures typecheck works without a prior sdk build, matching cli/tsconfig.json behavior. Scope: runner tsconfig. Detail: CI runs from a fresh checkout with no dist, so source mapping avoids build dependency.

eli5.text: When the code-checker tool tries to verify the runner program's types, it can now find the SDK source files automatically without waiting for a compiled copy to exist first. This matters during continuous integration where the project starts fresh with no build output, because the checker follows the direct path to the SDK's live source code instead of needing a previously-built package. The change keeps the project's automated checks working smoothly from a clean start, without changing any features or behavior you'd see.

ai.title: Freebuff Runner adds structured logger and logging wiring
ai.summary: The Freebuff Runner (@codebuff/freebuff-runner, the Bun worker that claims queued freebuff_agent_runs from Convex and runs the codebuff SDK harness in-process) gains a structured logger via a new freebuff/runner/src/logger.ts that builds @codebuff/common LogRow payloads tagged service=freebuff-runner and re-exports flushLogSink from @codebuff/logging. package.json adds the @codebuff/logging workspace dependency and main.ts sets FREEBUFF_RUNNER_ID and calls flushLogSink on graceful shutdown; every console.log/warn/error call in main.ts, eventBatcher.ts, and runTurn.ts is replaced with logger.info/warn/error calls that include runId context. The eventBatcher and runTurn modules now route flush, heartbeat, and error diagnostics through the logger instead of raw console output, so runner lifecycle and crash logs ship into the unified freebuff dataset.
ai.evidence: New file freebuff/runner/src/logger.ts defines LOG_SERVICE = 'freebuff-runner', re-exports flushLogSink from @codebuff/logging, and builds LogRow payloads; freebuff/runner/package.json adds "@codebuff/logging": "workspace:*"; main.ts sets process.env.FREEBUFF_RUNNER_ID = RUNNER_ID and calls flushLogSink on shutdown; eventBatcher.ts and runTurn.ts import { logger } from './logger' and replace console.log/warn/error calls with logger.info/warn/error.

entries.title: Packaging cleanup: README and 11 more

ai.title: Freebuff runner package removed
ai.summary: The `@codebuff/freebuff-runner` package at `freebuff/runner/` has been fully deleted, removing the Render-hosted Bun worker that offloaded Freebuff agent turns from Convex action compute. This eliminates the long-lived runner process (`src/main.ts`), the HTTP/WS `RunnerCtx` bridge (`src/convexBridge.ts`), the batched event flush (`src/eventBatcher.ts`), the Codex/Claude Code executors, the ported harness logic, and structured logging glue. Dispatch therefore reverts to the legacy Convex action and workflow paths; the `freebuff_runner_enabled` flag and the `runner_bridge` Convex helpers it depended on are no longer consumed by any runner-side code here, and the README's deploy-order warning about bringing the Render worker up before flipping the flag no longer applies.
ai.evidence: The diff deletes the entire `freebuff/runner/` package directory: `freebuff/runner/README.md`, `freebuff/runner/package.json`, `freebuff/runner/tsconfig.json`, and every source file under `freebuff/runner/src/` (`main.ts`, `convexBridge.ts`, `eventBatcher.ts`, `executeClaudeCode.ts`, `executeCodex.ts`, `harness.ts`, `logger.ts`, `runCliTurn.ts`, `runTurn.ts`, `webcontainerTools.ts`). The analysis notes confirm the package was added in an earlier commit [f7828c2c] and structured facts list the exports removed (`RunnerCtx`, `createRunnerCtx`, `createSubscriptionClient`, `createEventBatcher`, etc.).
ai.unknowns: Whether the `freebuff_runner_enabled` flag is also flipped back off and the `runner_bridge` Convex helpers are deleted in adjacent commits, and whether the sweep cron and requeue behavior the README described are being cleaned up elsewhere.

changes.what: Removed the entire `freebuff/runner/` package, including its manifest, tsconfig, and all source modules.
